init.title: Polling
init.description: The Miele consumer cloud is rate-limited and throws intermittent errors, so how often to poll is a trade-off. Adaptive polling uses the interval below when the cabinet is idle, drops to 10 s for a minute after you change something or while a door is open, and backs off automatically while the cloud is failing.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll when nothing is happening. 15-900 seconds; the default is 60.
data_description.adaptive: When off, the interval above is used at all times.
